answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn influence, then slash part of that stake when independent audits confirm coordinated false claims. A Sybil attacker must immobilize one full stake per account and risks losing it, so creating a hundred identities costs a hundred stakes plus foregone yield. An ocean of accounts cannot mask a shared operator when a sonnet of repeated claims maps onto an atlas of attestation links.
